facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 土_比肩 (Earth carrying The Twin). Persona The Twin (比肩). Definition line: "Same nature, same register, the standard you hold yourself to". Keyword Independence, charge steady, poles catalyst Self-trust / friction Isolation. Family function: Body. Cost dimension: the standard held to oneself; company that truly matches is rare. Arena: mirrors, stride, equal measure, walking beside. Classical portrait: same nature, same register; the standard held to oneself; self-reliance that can wall others out. Ruled domains: Peers, Independence, Self-reliance. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 劫财.
Element arena: Earth (ground, soil, load, field, bedrock, harvest). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Earth. structural_interaction seed: "Stability amplifying stability — holding force deepening without movement".
- k2_overview: "Your Earth moves as the Twin: ground that holds its own plot beside everyone else’s. You are the neighbor with the straight fence, generous across it, immovable about where it runs. Belonging matters to you, but merger does not. You stand with people the way hills stand in a range: together, and entirely yourselves."
- k2_functional: "Your energy is bedrock steady: unhurried, unshakable through long loads, renewed by routine."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Self-grounded","Solid","Dependable"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Peers":"Your peers are landholders like you: solid people with their own ground and no designs on yours. Trade help across fences freely. The neighbors you respect at seventy are the wealth this position promises.","Independence":"Earth independence is owned ground: a home, a trade, a name that stands without cosigners. You will have it, because you refuse alternatives. Just leave a gate in the fence.","Self-reliance":"You carry your own weather and everyone else’s overflow without filing complaints. Twice a year, let someone shovel your side. The ground stays firmer when it is not also the whole world’s floor."}
- fn_reading.friction.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.friction; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 土_劫财 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Ground-taking","Tenacious","Unbroken"],"friction":["Territorial","Holds grudges","Bulldozing"]}
- Sibling cell 土_劫财 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Yours is a word your body enforces before your mind gets consulted. The parking spot, the project, the Sunday routine: incursions get met with a speed that surprises even you. Most of the invasions were imaginary. The defense spending has been extremely real."

Core element Earth, energy element Earth. Law: Earth and Earth are the same element (the self pair). Relative to the core the energy is the self, so Earth is this core's Body. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Earth core that shows Earth on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Earth as the Body is the Overfueled band's case (the core has more than it channels); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 土_土's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.
